meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Brisk handles your data: what we collect, what we use it for, how long we keep it and which rights you have.

summary.1: We use your contact details to answer your enquiry.
summary.2: Google Analytics and analytics cookies load only with your permission.
summary.3: You can decline analytics and change your choice at any time.

who.title: Who we are
body: Brisk is a digital agency based in Limburg, Belgium. We design and build websites, webshops, software and mobile apps. This page explains which personal data we process through this website and why.
Brisk is the data controller for the information you leave here. Questions about it go to {email}.

collect.title: What we collect
body: We process the information needed for your enquiry and to operate the website. We collect analytics only if you choose to allow it.
list: Contact form: your name, email address, optionally your company name, the type of project, a budget indication and your message. Only name, email and message are required.
Server logs: our hosting provider records technical details such as IP address, browser, timestamp and requested page. This keeps the site secure and stable.
Google Analytics: only with permission, we collect usage information such as pages visited, interactions and browser and device information. The Google tag may set analytics cookies for this purpose.

We save your cookie preference in your browser’s local storage so you do not have to choose again on every visit. If your browser blocks this storage, your choice applies only to the current document.

use.title: What we use it for
body: We use your form details to answer your message and, if you want, to schedule a call and write a proposal. Server logs help us trace outages and prevent abuse.

If you allow analytics, we use Google Analytics to understand which pages are used and where we can improve the website. Advertising personalisation and Google signals are disabled in this integration.
We do not use your contact details for newsletters or other marketing unless you ask us to.

analytics.title: Google Analytics and your cookie preference
body: We use Google Analytics 4 for website statistics. Until you give permission, we do not load the Google tag and this integration sends no analytics data to Google. You can both allow and decline analytics in the cookie settings panel.

After permission is given, Google Analytics may use cookies including _ga and _ga_4TBZ9KYGCS to distinguish visits and maintain session information. We do not include completed contact form details in custom analytics events.

Use the button below or the cookie settings at the bottom of any page to review and change your choice. If you decline after previously allowing analytics, we disable further measurement for this Google Analytics property and remove its cookies that this website can access. This does not automatically delete information already processed.

Google processes the usage information sent after you give permission. You can also read Google’s explanation of data from websites that use its services. For questions about previously collected information, email {email}.
analytics.sourceLabel: How Google uses information from websites

retain.title: How long we keep it
body: Messages sent through the contact form are kept for as long as it takes to follow up on your question. If it turns into a project, we keep the correspondence for the duration of the project and the legal retention period afterwards. If it doesn't, we delete your data within twelve months.
Server logs are deleted automatically by our hosting provider after a short period.

third.title: Third parties
body: Service providers help us operate the website and deliver messages. If you allow analytics, Google also receives usage information through Google Analytics.
list: Hosting: the website and the contact form run with a hosting provider that keeps the server logs.
Email delivery: messages from the contact form are sent to our inbox through an email service.

Microlink: on a few pages we show live screenshots of our clients' public websites, fetched through Microlink. No data about you is passed along, apart from what a browser sends by default when loading an image.
Google Analytics: processes usage information for website statistics after you give permission. The Google Analytics section explains this and lets you change your choice.

rights.title: Your rights
body: Under the GDPR you have a number of rights over your personal data. You can exercise them by emailing us. We reply within a month.
list: Access: ask which data we hold about you.
Objection and restriction: object to a processing activity or have it restricted.
Portability: receive your data in a readable format.
Complaint: file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority if you believe we're not handling your data correctly.

contact.title: Contact
body: Questions about this policy or your data? Email {email}. We're based in {location}.
We update this policy when the way we work changes. The date at the top tells you when that last happened.
